recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色：瀰漫密集的中至大型腫瘤細胞呈清楚的細胞膜陽性，上方區域可見少數陰性的小血管與間質細胞；證明腫瘤為 B 細胞來源，是濾泡性淋巴瘤基本免疫表型的一部分。
features: Diffuse strong membranous CD20 staining in densely packed tumor cells
Positive cells are medium to large with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Occasional larger positive cells with vesicular nuclei (centroblast-like)
Negative endothelial and stromal cells in the upper field
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows strong membranous staining of the densely packed medium to large neoplastic cells, including scattered larger centroblast-like cells, with negative endothelial and stromal cells in the upper portion of the field. The staining confirms a B-cell lineage of the neoplastic population. CD20 alone does not separate follicular lymphoma from other B-cell lymphomas and must be combined with CD10, BCL6, BCL2 and architectural assessment. Findings are consistent with a B-cell lymphoma, in this case follicular lymphoma grade 3a.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is also CD20 positive but lacks follicular architecture and CD21/CD23-positive follicular dendritic cell meshworks.
Reactive follicles are CD20 positive as well but show BCL2-negative germinal centers and preserved polarization.
MCL is CD20 positive but composed of small monotonous cells that are CD5+, cyclin D1+ and CD10 negative.
